input_contract.whole_stream_hash_policy: Huge streams are identified by absolute path and byte length; the digest covers the concatenated raw H4CR records whose domain_id is 54.

interpretation_limits: Legacy 52/64 D54 records do not contain engine order instance id, assigned-division ids, or exact active state.
A legacy (army_id,generation,slot) mutation is a surrogate candidate and cannot satisfy same-instance acceptance.
Melted-save membership cannot establish same-boundary equality without an authenticated matching live observation.
Empty or zero-order direct-root observations do not prove a complete manager/container walk or inactive-army coverage.
purpose: Deterministic read-only inventory; not a promotion verifier.

empty_inactive_manager.reason: No retained D54 direct-root observation contains an empty army and the wire has no complete-manager admission receipt.

same_instance_type2_redraw_delete.reason: No current 60/88 record exists; legacy mutations and tombstones omit +0x244 identity.

type4_discrimination.reason: No observed stream row or melted-save order has type 4, and the inputs contain no authenticated same-boundary live/save pair.
